name: io.github.jztan/qt4-doc-mcp-server
description: Offline MCP server for local Qt 4.8, Qt 5, and Qt 6 documentation with full-text search.

environmentVariables.description: Absolute path to a local Qt 4.8, Qt 5, or Qt 6 HTML documentation root (required)
environmentVariables.name: QT_DOC_BASE

environmentVariables.description: Writable directory for the search index and Markdown cache (default: $QT_DOC_BASE/.index; set when the documentation root is read-only)
environmentVariables.name: QT_DOC_STATE_DIR
